newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bezeq taps Merrill to lead bond offer.
newsitem.headline: Bezeq taps Merrill to lead bond offer.

text.p: Merrill Lynch will lead manage a $200 million issue of Yankee bonds for Bezeq Israel Telecom in the company's first ever overseas debt offering, a Bezeq spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
The offering will occur sometime in the second quarter and Goldman Sachs, Salomon Brothers and Bank of America will co-manage it. Bezeq said the bonds would have a maturity of at least 10 years.
Bezeq, Israel's main telecommunications carrier, said it now planned to seek credit ratings from Standard & Poor's and Moody's.

"Bezeq will diversify its sources of financing, which until now have been from bank loans and private placements in the domestic market and syndicated loans in the international financial markets," Bezeq's chief financial officer, Avi Hochman, said in a statement.
Earlier this week, Bezeq said it was raising $100 million from a consortium of foreign banks.
Last month the Israel Electric Corp became the first state-owned company to tap the U.S. bond market with a private placement of $600 million in long-term bonds.
The government, which controls 76 percent of Bezeq, plans to make a global offering in the company later this year.
